title: Can a Teenager Fool an AI? Evaluating Low-Cost Cosmetic Attacks on Age Estimation Systems
abstract: arXiv:2602.19539v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Age estimation systems are increasingly deployed as gatekeepers for age-restricted online content, yet their robustness to cosmetic modifications has not been systematically evaluated. We investigate whether simple, household-accessible cosmetic changes, including beards, grey hair, makeup, and simulated wrinkles, can cause AI age estimators to classify minors as adults. To study this threat at scale without ethical concerns, we simulate these physical attacks on 329 facial images of individuals aged 10 to 21 using a VLM image editor (Gemini 2.5 Flash Image). We then evaluate eight models from our prior benchmark: five specialized architectures (MiVOLO, Custom-Best, Herosan, MiViaLab, DEX) and three vision-language models (Gemini 3 Flash, Gemini 2.5 Flash, GPT-5-Nano). translated_title: 青少年能骗过AI吗？评估针对年龄估计系统的低成本化妆攻击
translated_abstract: 年龄估计系统日益被部署为年龄限制在线内容的守门员，但其对化妆修饰的鲁棒性尚未得到系统性评估。我们研究了简单的、家庭可获得的化妆改变——包括留胡须、染灰白发、化妆和模拟皱纹——是否能导致AI年龄估计器将未成年人误分类为成年人。为了在没有伦理顾虑的情况下大规模研究这一威胁，我们使用VLM图像编辑器（Gemini 2.5 Flash Image）在329张年龄为10至21岁个体的面部图像上模拟这些物理攻击。随后，我们评估了来自先前基准测试的八个模型：五个专用架构（MiVOLO、Custom-Best、Herosan、MiViaLab、DEX）和三个视觉语言模型（Gemini 3 Flash、Gemini 2.5 Flash、GPT-5-Nano）。我们提出了攻击转化率（ACR）这一指标，其定义为基线时被预测为未成年人的图像在攻击后翻转为成年人的比例，这是一种与人群无关的……
tldr: 该研究利用VLM图像编辑器模拟留胡须、染灰发、化妆等低成本化妆攻击，并引入攻击转化率（ACR）指标，系统评估了八个年龄估计模型，发现简单的家庭化妆手段即可使AI将未成年人误判为成年人。
en_tdlr: This study simulates low-cost, household-accessible cosmetic attacks (beards, grey hair, makeup, wrinkles) on 329 facial images of minors using a VLM image editor, and introduces the Attack Conversion Rate (ACR) metric to systematically evaluate eight age estimation models, revealing that simple cosmetic changes can cause AI age estimators to misclassify minors as adults.
